# LocalReadTranslate formula interoperability corpus

01. Basic equality: $x+y=z$.
02. Subscript: $x_i$.
03. Superscript: $x^2$.
04. Combined scripts: $x_i^2$.
05. Fraction: $\frac{a}{b}$.
06. Square root: $\sqrt{x}$.
07. Indexed root: $\sqrt[n]{x}$.
08. Summation: $\sum_{i=1}^{n} i$.
09. Product: $\prod_{k=1}^{n} k$.
10. Definite integral: $\int_0^1 x\,dx$.
11. Double integral: $\iint_D f(x,y)\,dA$.
12. Limit: $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$.
13. Partial derivative: $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$.
14. Gradient: $\nabla f(x)$.
15. Greek letters: $\alpha+\beta=\gamma$.
16. Inequality: $a\leq b$.
17. Not equal: $a\neq b$.
18. Approximation: $a\approx b$.
19. Membership: $x\in A$.
20. Subset: $A\subseteq B$.
21. Union: $A\cup B$.
22. Intersection: $A\cap B$.
23. Quantifiers: $\forall x\,\exists y$.
24. Blackboard bold: $x\in\mathbb{R}$.
25. Bold vector: $\mathbf{x}$.
26. Hat accent: $\hat{x}$.
27. Bar accent: $\bar{x}$.
28. Arrow vector: $\vec{x}$.
29. Overline: $\overline{AB}$.
30. Underbrace: $\underbrace{a+\cdots+a}_{n\text{ terms}}$.
31. Overbrace: $\overbrace{x+\cdots+x}^{n}$.
32. Trigonometric function: $\sin^2 x+\cos^2 x=1$.
33. Logarithm: $\log_a b=\frac{\ln b}{\ln a}$.
34. Euler identity: $e^{i\pi}+1=0$.
35. Absolute value: $\left|x\right|$.
36. Norm: $\left\lVert x\right\rVert_2$.
37. Binomial coefficient: $\binom{n}{k}$.
38. Function composition: $(f\circ g)(x)$.
39. Mapping: $f:X\to Y$.
40. Probability: $\Pr(X\geq x)$.

41. Matrix:

$$
\begin{matrix}
a & b \\
c & d
\end{matrix}
$$

42. Parenthesized matrix:

$$
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0 \\
0 & 1
\end{pmatrix}
$$

43. Piecewise function:

$$
f(x)=
\begin{cases}
x^2, & x\geq0 \\
-x, & x<0
\end{cases}
$$

44. Aligned equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}
a &= b+c \\
d &= e-f
\end{aligned}
$$

45. Determinant:

$$
\det\begin{pmatrix}
a & b \\
c & d
\end{pmatrix}=ad-bc
$$

46. Set builder:

$$
A=\left\{x\in\mathbb{R}:x>0\right\}
$$

47. Ordered tuple:

$$
(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n)
$$

48. Expectation:

$$
\mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_x x\,\Pr(X=x)
$$

49. Optimization:

$$
x^\star=\arg\min_{x\in X} f(x)
$$

50. Infinite series:

$$
\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n^2}=\frac{\pi^2}{6}
$$
